name: Leave a no-mow strip
text: Let grass grow tall along the water.

name: Mow to the water
text: Neat and tidy, right to the edge.

name: Fertilizer flyer
text: Ask neighbors to skip summer fertilizer.

name: Clear the outlet
text: Pull debris from the overflow pipe.

name: Empty the sediment trap
text: Dig out the sand it caught.

name: Pull weeds and algae
text: Rake out mats and weeds by hand.
